rows.title: Dental Insurance Verification Specialist
reasons: The role is a Dental Insurance Verification Specialist, which is a completely different profession from the candidate's web development and SEO background.
The candidate has no experience with dental insurance, Dentrix, or HIPAA, which are core requirements.
The job requires 3-5 years of dental insurance verification experience, while the candidate has 2 years of web development experience.
